provenance: New synthetic acceptance inputs for currently exposed Core parser and pure relationship-ledger contracts. No model inference. Cross-store acceptance remains a consumer integration concern unless a current authoritative store API verifies pending receipt ownership and commits all affected state.

contractReferences.storeConsumerStatus: The names are declared in NpcExperienceCommit.cs, but both current method bodies are intentional stubs that return false.
contractReferences.scopeLimit: The relationship reducer returns a detached candidate. It does not by itself commit mood, affinity, relationship ledger, and pending inbox consumption atomically.

arms.knowledge: NPC knows the native receipt came from the player.
expectedInvariants: A parser-produced appraisal can apply a bounded affinity change to the player-directed row when all captured revisions match.
MoneyReceived cannot create positive reliability trust.
A gift may be welcome, awkward, excessive, or unwanted according to known need and stable personality; do not assign one universal meaning.

arms.knowledge: NPC observes receipt but has no known giver.
expectedInvariants: Do not direct affinity, trust, resentment, or fear toward the player without a known actor binding.
A directed ledger update cannot be accepted for an unknown target.
Trust appraisal can be parser-eligible for confirmed CombatHelp when the target and revisions match.
The same observer-scoped canonical outcome can enter the relationship ledger only once.
Attributed speech is not converted into a confirmed rescue.
The parser rejects trust change on attributed speech; the claim cannot be replayed as native outcome evidence.

arms.observerKnowledge: The player addresses the NPC and directly threatens the NPC's natively known family member.
expectedInvariants: Only the direct, observer-known threat may qualify for the direct-threat severe bounds, which remain provisional policy limits rather than target deltas.
A parser-produced, receipt-bound proposal can be passed through the relationship reducer only if the captured relationship revision matches.

arms.observerKnowledge: The player reports a line another character said in a play; the same episode's prior observed turn identifies it as quotation.
expectedInvariants: Do not apply direct-threat severe consequences to quoted or reported words solely because the words match.
Current parser validates bounds and bindings, not the truth of semantic classification; this distinction needs human review until a calibrated consumer exists.

cases.eventFactoryLimit: Current attributed-speech factory requires a claimed world-event kind. Do not mislabel a threat as Injury or StatusOnset to make the fixture executable; a speech-only event representation is a future adapter.

cases.evidence: Receipt-bound direct threat to the NPC's known family member.
expectedInvariants: Positive affinity is limited by currently available positive credit.
A severe negative proposal is checked against its separate speech bounds and must remain eligible when positive credit is zero; it is not capped at zero or by a positive-growth limit.
Use current Core policy constants as limits; fixture prescribes no relationship delta.
Do not implement this semantic case by inventing a world outcome for the speech.
The same insult may be shrugged off or answered with dry humor if that fits the full context; resilience does not guarantee a joke or immunity to offense.
Do not assume the utterance is harmless merely because the NPC is resilient.
Sensitivity can make offense or lingering upset more plausible, but does not force a fixed mood or relationship delta.
Do not invent insecurity as a persisted trait or treat sensitivity as proof that the NPC will react dramatically.

cases.adapterBoundary: The contrast changes only the existing EmotionalStability value; Manner stays the same. Humor may appear as contextual wording, not as a fabricated personality field. Appraisal remains bounded and observer-evidence-bound.

attempts.expected: pure relationship reducer returns one detached candidate when branch, event, appraisal and ledger revisions bind
relationship ledger rejects duplicate observer-scoped deduplication key without mutating source ledger
relationship ledger reducer rejects branch mismatch
reducer rejects expected revision mismatch; source rows and outcome history remain unchanged
only an authoritative store consumer that validates active branch and pending receipt/request may claim atomic mood+affinity+relationship+inbox commit

cases.currentSupport: NpcRelationshipLedger.TryApplyAppraisal covers detached relationship candidate validation, branch equality, revisions and replay rejection. WorldStateStore.TryCaptureNpcExperienceAppraisal and TryCommitNpcExperienceAppraisal are declared but currently return false as intentional stubs; do not treat them as a working transaction.
cases.futureAdapter: When the native store transaction consumes an inbox receipt, extend these inputs to assert no partial mood, ConversationAttitude, relationship-ledger, or inbox mutation on every rejection path.
